title: City of Mission 2023 SOFI: complete named employee remuneration and expenses
notes: Every published name, title where present, separate remuneration and expense cell was checked on actual PDF-painted source images; independent Tesseract and Paddle OCR outputs and their source-reviewed corrections remain separate.
An independent peer transcribed the complete source-image scope before full candidate comparison. Prior context disclosures and reviewer-only rereads remain in the immutable peer receipts.
Repeated names or initials remain distinct literal observations; no identity merging, full-name enrichment, annualization or redistribution of aggregate amounts.
The separate source expense-inclusive Total column, when printed, is retained only in supporting evidence and is never substituted for remuneration.
Printed schedule year and signed approval are independently recorded; URL/upload dates are not used as reporting-year evidence.

definitions.remuneration: Includes any form of salary, wage, gratuities and taxable benefits, including applicable vehicle allowances paid to the employee or on behalf of an employee.
definitions.expenses: Includes travel expenses, memberships, tuition, relocation, vehicle reimbursements, and registration fees paid directly to an employee or to a third party on behalf of an employee.
definitions.financialStatementRelation: Schedule is based on actual payments made during the year; financial statements are prepared on an accrual basis.
definitions.sourceNamedSubtotalLabel: Subtotal - employees with remuneration and expenses exceeding $75,000
definitions.thresholdMeaning: Retain every printed named row, including individual remuneration below$75,000. Do not silently convert this combined source label into a salary-only selection rule.

publicWarning: The 148 named employee rows total CAD 16,445,762 remuneration and 318,887 known expenses. The printed named-employee remuneration subtotal is 16,445,765, 3 higher; its expense subtotal agrees. Physical 6 employee rows total 4,050,146 remuneration versus printed page subtotal 4,050,149, also 3 higher. Blaschuk, S visibly prints 93,271 remuneration and 1,718 expenses (sum 94,989), while its separate printed expense-inclusive Total is 94,992, 3 higher. Every individual cell is retained as visibly printed; no cause is inferred and no amount is balanced. Nine printed expense dashes remain null. The source uses a combined remuneration-and-expenses named-selection label; the below-75,000 remuneration rows remain as published. Retain the compiled partition: no compatible same-calendar-year compiled cohort has been established. Root owns any future period mapping or deletion; full strict multiset comparison is pinned separately.
